title: Adding model fields and migration conventions
answers: How do I add a field to a PostHog model with a migration?
Where do product model migrations live?
body:
- Core models: `posthog/models/`, migrations `posthog/migrations/` (`max_migration.txt` tracks latest). Product models: `products/<name>/backend/models/` with `products/<name>/backend/migrations/`; see `products/README.md` ("Adding or moving backend models and migrations"); scaffold `hogli product:bootstrap`. Use string FKs (`"posthog.Team"`).
- Separate product DBs declared in `products/db_routing.yaml`; no cross-DB FKs/migration deps (`test_migration_dependencies_share_a_database.py`).
- Generate: `DEBUG=1 ./manage.py makemigrations [app]`; conflicts: `manage.py rebase_migration <app>`.
- NOT NULL: set both `default=` and `db_default=`. Growing enums: module-level callable for `choices=`. Remove column: `deprecate_field`/`untrack_field`, never plain RemoveField. Drop table: `SafeDropTable`.
- Don't add domain fields to Team; use extension model (OneToOne primary_key, `posthog/models/team/extensions.py:register_team_extension_signal`, see team/README.md).
- Analyzer: `posthog/management/migration_analysis/` (policies.py e.g. HotTableAlterPolicy, AtomicFalsePolicy w/ atomic_false_acknowledged_migrations.txt).
says: Add field to model with migration
Safely adding column to existing table
search: Adding model fields and migrations requires separate locations by database: core models in posthog/models/ with migrations in posthog/migrations/ (tracked by max_migration.txt), product models in products/<name>/backend/ with separate migrations; declare product databases in products/db_routing.yaml with no cross-DB foreign keys or migration dependencies (enforced by test_migration_dependencies_share_a_database.py). NOT NULL fields must set both default= and db_default=; use module-level callables for growing enum choices; generate with DEBUG=1 ./manage.py makemigrations [app] and resolve conflicts via manage.py rebase_migration <app>. Never use RemoveField or RemoveTable directly; instead use deprecate_field/untrack_field for columns and SafeDropTable for tables. Domain fields belong in extension models (OneToOne with primary_key in posthog/models/team/extensions.py:register_team_extension_signal), not on Team itself. Use string foreign keys (e.g., "posthog.Team") and run the migration analyzer (posthog/management/migration_analysis/policies.py) to check policies like HotTableAlterPolicy and AtomicFalsePolicy.
